suppressed.explanation: subprocess module calls execute external commands. Without careful input validation, this enables command injection.
suppressed.finding:
proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
suppressed.remediation: Use subprocess.run() with shell=False and an explicit argument list. Validate all inputs and avoid passing user-controlled data to commands.
suppressed.suppression_reason: subprocess.run with an argv array and a timeout for smartctl, sensors and notify-send; no shell, no alert-derived tokens.

suppressed.explanation: Credentials or environment variables flow to a network sink. This is a high-confidence indicator of credential exfiltration.
suppressed.pattern: Tainted flow: 'req' from os.environ.get (line 117, credential/environment) → urllib.request.urlopen (network output)
suppressed.remediation: Never send credentials or environment variables over the network. Use secure credential stores and avoid transmitting secrets in request bodies or URLs.
